news.title: Asana names Natalie Kouzeleas as general manager for EMEA | ChannelPro
Asana Names Natalie Kouzeleas EMEA General Manager
Asana Names Natalie Kouzeleas GM for EMEA -

bullets: Set and drive the product strategy and joint roadmap for reporting across two teams, from the reporting engine to AI-generated dashboards and reports.
Decide how new use cases fit the reporting platform: when to extend an existing pattern, when to invest in a new one, and what evidence justifies the bigger bet.
Launch AI-powered reporting, starting with chart creation and insights, then reports that write themselves and a company-wide view for leadership teams.
Align partner teams across AI agents, integrations and permissions on shared outcomes, and route requests that belong elsewhere with a clear rationale.
Partner closely with engineering and design so product and engineering work on the same problems, and keep value reaching customers during long platform work.
Own the product vision and prioritized roadmap for AI Studio end to end, tying every investment directly to customer impact, business outcomes, and Asana’s mission.
Drive direct business outcomes for a consumption-based AI product: own reporting, forecasting, and ROI, and define the metrics that connect product usage to revenue on a…
Scale AI Studio to reliably support millions of workflows, ensuring the quality, performance, and dependability enterprises require for system-critical processes.
Ship automation capabilities that enable enterprise teams to deploy AI across their organizations, ranging from single-team workflows to processes spanning thousands of users.
Build for enterprise trust by shaping AI governance, admin controls, and change management capabilities so customers can roll out AI confidently and safely at scale.
